data.title: SaaS Marketing Site
data.tagline: Place the value, product proof, and next action on one clear reading path
data.description: A SaaS marketing site is a common website pattern, not a formal visual movement. It organizes a conversion path around the problem the product solves: a focused hero states the promise, real product views and customer evidence build trust, and a consistent call to action moves the visitor toward a trial or conversation. The visual style can vary, but decoration cannot replace product proof or a clear next step.

use: SaaS, AI tools, and developer products that must explain capability and encourage signup
Products with a useful interface to show , where the real workflow can become the visual lead
Longer sales journeys that need evidence and scenarios to reduce perceived risk
Brands that will keep expanding and benefit from reusable product, data, and content modules
avoid: Fill the first screen with feature cards before the visitor understands what the product is
Use gradients instead of product proof , leaving a technology mood but no concrete understanding
Present several competing primary actions for trial, purchase, contact, and download
Copy another SaaS company's structure and language ; specificity builds more trust than familiarity

data.agentPrompt: SaaS product marketing website, one focused value proposition, real product interface as the main visual, customer logos and specific metrics for trust, one clear primary action, soft gradient used only as atmosphere, restrained card hierarchy, calm and precise
